notes: All 118 pieces from the parts list are nodes (b1..b118 in build order); colours come from the parts list and the step pictures.

Many step pictures are small, so the exact contact between pieces in the face and collar layers (steps 13-36) is partly inferred. Stud ports are left null for that reason. Each stud connection is written as u = piece whose studs are underneath, v = piece placed on top. For the back frame (bricks, round bricks, plate 1x10), u is the piece whose studs go into the baseplate.
The four 4x12 white plates (b1, b11, b12, b20) form the 12x16 canvas. They are held together by the plates and bricks that span their seams, not by joins between each other.

The eyes in step 33 are built twice: a 2x6 double-corner plate with two half-circle tiles. I wrote them out as separate nodes instead of a repeat, because every piece must have a unique id in build order.
Step 25's 1x10 plate (b70) is assumed to sit on the 1x10 brick b62 at the opposite end of the back frame. The picture is ambiguous.

The stand is the elbows, red axle and two grey axles, with a hinge cylinder on the end of each axle. The cylinders click onto the two hinge plates. That hinge join is the only revolute one besides the nose hinge (b107/b118).
The yellow bow-tie centre tile (b94) is assumed to snap over the stud of the jumper plate (b55).
